messages:
Lina: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 — migration guide (v2->v3 SDK), fixes to Python snippet, and some wording tweaks. Can reviewers for style/terminology take a pass today? Prefer concise, active voice.

Kevin: I'll take the lexicon pass. Anything specific I should watch for? a terminology list or voice pointers?

Lina: Thanks — focus on: avoid 'production model' (use 'pin model version'), replace vague 'users' with 'developers' or 'end customers', prefer 'the Redwood API' over 'our API' in public docs. Also ensure SDK examples follow the one-liner pattern and don't return huge objects.

Kevin: Got it. Starting now and I'll leave inline suggestions.

Jun: Ping me if the docs-preview CI flakes. I can re-run the job; it has been timing out on link-checker this morning. Also prefer fenced code blocks with language tag for snippets.

Asha: Quick style nit: avoid marketing adjectives in the guide (e.g., 'best-in-class'); keep neutral descriptive tone. And prefer American English spellings per style guide (e.g., 'configure' not 'config').

Priyanka: On the Python snippet — prefer showing minimal imports and only the field readers (e.g., .text). Suggest replacing the current example with:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...")
print(resp.text)
```
This keeps examples short and copy-paste friendly.

Kevin: Left comments on the PR for wording swaps and added a tiny glossary entry for 'pin model version' vs 'model pinning'. Also suggested changing 'cold start' to 'initial latency' where appropriate.

Lina: DocsBot reports preview FAILED — link-checker flagged /old-sdk/migrate. Jun can you re-run? This will block merge.

Jun: Re-run kicked. Also I can add a temporary redirect in the v2->v3 mapping so the link-checker passes while we fix the canonical path.

DocsBot: preview rerun started by Jun at 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z

Kevin: Two lexicon approvals so far; we still need an engineering/code snippet check. Asha or Priyanka — can one of you confirm the snippet is accurate?

Asha: I'll review the snippet for API usage and spacing.

Priyanka: LGTM on the snippet after adding the import. Approving now. :thumbsup:

Lina: Great — approvals from Kevin and Priyanka. Asha, do you have any blockers?

Asha: Approved. Left one whitespace nit but not blocking.

Lina: Plan: merge today before 18:00 PT unless preview fails again. I'll hold the merge if anything else appears.

DocsBot: preview job PASSED at 2026-03-21T15:12:48Z

Lina: Merged the PR. Thanks everyone for the quick signoffs. Filing a follow-up issue to add a permanent redirect for the old migration link and to sweep other v2 references.
